0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Minnesota Timberwolves on the road against the Miami Heat, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Minnesota a 50% win chance. Donte DiVincenzo is out after Achilles surgery, while Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, LaMelo Ball and Rudy Gobert are day-to-day with rest listed as the reason, and all four are game-time decisions. For Miami, Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Ezra Ausar (undisclosed), Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
